Name: (CP) Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits (UPD 1.4)
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
[center][color=#6aa84f][size=5]-----------------------------
[u][b]Description[/b][/u]
-----------------------------[/size][/color][/center][size=3]Hello Everyone!

﻿This mod, as the brief overview explains, edits over, via content patcher, the Portraits found in the wonderful mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Aesthetic for SVE[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url]﻿﻿, with Anime-Styled versions of the characters found in Stardew Valley Expanded. Artwork has been completed for ALL characters found in the mod! Fortunately this was accomplished via the support/permission of many other artists which allowed me to either make edits of works they have already done or even work given me permission to upload some works they've completed themselves all of which is available to be used, even in cases where multiple artists have done one character in their own differing styles, Just go to the mod settings and select which version of the character from any available artist in the dropdown, image of every character with small description of image revealing their corresponding artists can be seen in the image tab of the mod page!

If you're an artist yourself and have done some work for SVE in a style of Anime you'd like to showcase in my mod please feel free to reach out even if you  only make edits to outfits, otherwise if you'd provide me a way to reach out to an artist who's work you're particularly invested in I'd love to reach out myself.

This mod as said previously, is done with content patcher integration, meaning it's a simple drag and drop the mod into your Stardew Valley's Mod folder and have any required mods and it'll work just like that, no issues whatsoever, Possibly working with Vortex manager but I'm not so keen on doing that myself :)

[color=#00ffff]TO CLARIFY: After downloading the mod file extract the downloaded 7 zip file then take the folder: "[CP] Donut's Seasonal Anime Characters SVE" and place that into your mod folder[/color]
[/size]
[center][color=#6d9eeb][size=5]----------------------------------
[u]Potential Problems[/u]
----------------------------------[/size]
[/color][/center][size=3]The Only issue I know about my mod that I myself can confirm, which is not really an issue from my end and more-so just a missing feature (TODO) is that though Poltergeister's mod targets the portraits of the Characters of SVE accordingly, there are instances of events found in SVE which use "Temporary" Actors which is to say that these NPCs are just one-time-use clones of the Original NPC which don't have the same Id's (Target Names for Content Patcher Users) so their code doesn't target them as it isn't needed for them generally since their art-style is vanilla and corresponds to their art. Of course the Anime stylization is noticeably different making these cutscenes quite jarring when playing. Same thing could be said for the vendor images But I've taken the time to correct those, making that issue solved. For these events I plan to go over the code of SVE and find these Actors in the future and have done so for one event so far giving me confidence that I am capable of solving any issues of the sort when and wherever they may occur.

I humbly ask that you provide comments of "bug reports" wherever events like these occur in order to help me more easily find the events and rectify these issues, please provide the location, maybe a brief description of the event, and NPCs/Actors included in these reports, once again thanks to anybody who provides help with this![/size]


[center]﻿[/center][center][color=#fff2cc][size=5]----------------------------------
[u]Updates/Logs[/u]
----------------------------------
[/size][/color][/center][size=3]1.0: As many may know I have a previous version of this mod up which was simply a replacer but I haven't just uploaded the same thing but with Content Patcher Compatibility, that'd be a bit redundant. No I've uploaded this version with many small tweaks to my Original Artworks including some new artworks done for Characters I've previously done which are more up to my new standards for myself lol, hope you'll enjoy these new changes and of course, all my old works are still included in this mod but need to be selected from the settings tab for it. Other than that this mods now features artwork for all previous characters missed in my old version, Please Enjoy!

[/size]1.1: Added new Portrait Option for victor by BunBunz, Seasonal Outfits being created by YasoAtNexus, Hotfix added Missing portraits for Wizard and Martin

1.2: Created A Patch within my mod's options to allow users of Rasmodia The Witch mod to Use Seasonal Anime-styled Portraits of Rasmodia by KlevLovins! new Portraits stylized in the designs of Poltergeister outfits for Seasonal Cute Characters SVE for Marlon, Code that targets png files within SVE for each character to solve any Temp Actor Issues

1.3: Added  to manifest unique token for Vanilla Seasonal Cute Characters for Gil and Sandy to work with this mod. added New Seasonal Cute Stylized Portraits for Sandy, added Jadu Portrait Variation by BunBunz, Suki portraits, and Reuploaded Gil portraits

1.4: Fixed Gunther Code not running, Made edits for Gunther Outfits giving it a more stylized look for Seasonal Cute Characters. Updated Rasmodia's Portrait Sheet to 12 frames as per required by Rasmodia Mod
